pokedex.476: It radiates such a powerful magnetic field that nearby electrical appliances become unusable.
pokedex.478: When it finds humans or Pokémon it likes, it freezes them and takes them to its chilly den, where they become decorations.
pokedex.506: Because it doesn’t yelp, it’s extremely popular with Trainers who live in apartment buildings.
pokedex.507: Its dense black fur grows continuously. The high cost of keeping its hard fur properly groomed makes this a troublesome Pokémon to train.
pokedex.508: Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant, it’s a trustworthy partner on rescue teams.
pokedex.524: Born deep within the ground, it compares itself with similar species, such as Geodude and Carbink, to settle which has the hardest body.
pokedex.525: Its orange crystal is a mass of energy. Just one crystal fragment would provide enough fuel for a hundred dump trucks.
pokedex.526: The blasts of energy it makes from sunbeams have terrifying power. However, it’s not able to fire its blasts at night or on rainy days.
pokedex.546: When it finds others of its kind, they all stick together. When enough of them have collected, the mass resembles a cumulonimbus cloud.
pokedex.547: It rides on the wind and slips into people’s homes. After it has turned a room into a cotton- filled mess, it giggles to itself and takes off.
pokedex.548: Although the leaves on its head are bitter enough to cause dizziness, they provide relief from weariness—even more so when boiled.
pokedex.549: No matter how much time and money is spent raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when they bloom in the wild.
pokedex.550: Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.
pokedex.551: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.
pokedex.552: They move in groups of a few individuals. A female is often the leader of the group, and the males will gather food.
pokedex.553: Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of a sandstorm.
pokedex.559: They move in small groups, walking around lazily. Anyone who makes eye contact gets smacked with a headbutt.
pokedex.560: This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.
pokedex.564: Based on studies of its skeletal structure, it can apparently dive to ocean depths of over half a mile.
pokedex.565: It constructed its sturdy shell by crunching and swallowing the hard shells or bones of its prey.
pokedex.566: It is the ancestor of all bird Pokémon. Archen itself could not actually fly but moved by hopping from treetop to treetop.
pokedex.567: Although apparently able to fly, they tended to run along the ground, averaging speeds of roughly 25 mph.
pokedex.568: Unsanitary places are what they like best. They can be spotted in Alola, often with Grimer in hot pursuit.
pokedex.569: Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you’ll experience the effects of the unidentified toxin.
pokedex.570: This Pokémon has a cowardly disposition, so when it’s not around friends, it basically always stays transformed as something else.
pokedex.571: It doesn’t just transform itself—it also has the power to make hundreds of people see its illusions.
pokedex.572: A clean freak that will not allow even the slightest mess, it uses its tail like a mop to thoroughly clean any and all filth.
pokedex.573: The white parts of its coat are covered in an oil secreted from its body, so this Pokémon can slide right away from its enemies’ attacks.
pokedex.582: Born of an icicle, this Pokémon uses its frosty breath to make ice crystals, causing snow to fall.
pokedex.583: Hot days cause its body to melt. It can be restored by refreezing it, but the process leaves its body slightly warped.
pokedex.584: Each of its two heads has a brain, and when they are in agreement, it attacks its enemies by exhaling a violent blizzard.
pokedex.587: It glides using its cape-like membrane. Electrical energy scatters from it, shocking its friends and foes alike.
pokedex.592: It wraps its veillike arms and legs around prey swimming by and drags them down to the depths of the ocean.
pokedex.593: Jellicent is always hanging around fancy cruise ships and tankers, hoping to drag away its prey.
pokedex.594: It uses its special mucus to close the wounds of injured Pokémon. The reason for this behavior remains unknown.
pokedex.605: It controls tremendous psychic power. Most reports of alien sightings are actually just people mistaking Elgyem for an alien.
pokedex.606: With its psychic powers, it rewrites its opponents’ memories. You, too, may have already had your memories rewritten.
pokedex.619: They can often be seen in packs in the morning, slowly moving their bodies through a series of poses.
pokedex.620: It overwhelms its opponents with continuous attacks and then slowly stores up power before delivering the finishing blow.
pokedex.621: The red skin on its face is harder than rock. In narrow caves, it squares off against its enemies and charges face-first right into them.
pokedex.622: Its movements are powered by a mysterious energy. It has continued to move since ancient times, so its power may soon run out.
pokedex.623: Some say that ancient people invented Golurk to serve as a laborer. It follows its master’s orders faithfully.
pokedex.624: After shredding its prey, it sharpens its blades on a stone by the river. Each Pawniard has its own favorite sharpening stone.
pokedex.625: No matter how strong the Bisharp, it’s said that if the blade on its head is chipped, it will retire from its position as the boss.
pokedex.627: They pick fights indiscriminately. They grow stronger and more powerful each time they faint or are injured.
pokedex.628: With its brave disposition, it fears nothing—not even death. Ancient Alolan people respected it, referring to it as “the hero of the sky.”
pokedex.629: It protects its plump posterior with the bones of prey it has consumed. As it grows, it replaces the bones.
pokedex.630: They adorn themselves beautifully with bones. This is supposedly an effort to attract males, but no male Mandibuzz have ever been found.
pokedex.636: When battling opponents, it sprays fire from its five horns. The max temperature of the flames can reach nearly 5,500 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokedex.637: As it flies, it scatters its flaming scales. It was feared by ancient people, who referred to it as “the rage of the sun.”
pokedex.661: This amiable Pokémon is easy to train. But when battle is joined, it shows its ferocious side.
pokedex.662: From its beak, it fires embers at its prey. Once it has caught them, it grills them at high heat before feasting upon them.
pokedex.663: Its favorite foods are Wingull and Pikipek. It attacks with a powerful kick and grasps them firmly in its talons.
pokedex.667: When they’re young, they live with a pride. Once they’re able to hunt prey on their own, they’re kicked out and have to make their own way.
pokedex.668: The males are usually lazy, but when attacked by a strong foe, a male will protect its friends with no regard for its own safety.
pokedex.669: It’s not safe without the power of a flower, but it will keep traveling around until it finds one with the color and shape it wants.
pokedex.670: It raises flowers and uses them as weapons. The more gorgeous the blossom, the more power it contains.
pokedex.671: It controls the flowers it grows. The petal blizzards that Florges triggers are overwhelming in their beauty and power.
pokedex.674: It grows up imitating the behavior of Pangoro, which it looks up to as a leader.
pokedex.675: It boasts superb physical strength. Those who wish to become Pangoro’s Trainer have no choice but to converse with their fists.
pokedex.676: There was an era when aristocrats would compete to see who could trim their Furfrou’s fur into the most exquisite style.
pokedex.686: It draws prey near with its blinking lights and then wraps them up in its long tentacles and holds them in place.
pokedex.687: When it comes to strong hypnosis, there’s an endless number of people who utilize Malamar for their nefarious deeds.
pokedex.690: It vanishes into seaweed and remains perfectly still to avoid attacks from large Pokémon. Rotten seaweed is its main food source.
pokedex.691: This vicious Pokémon sprays a poisonous liquid on opponents that come near. For whatever reason, it gets along really well with Dhelmise.
pokedex.692: Its claws occasionally fall off, and it keeps a low profile until they grow back. The meat of its claws is so delicious!
pokedex.693: It compresses the water it has sucked up and then projects it with enough power to punch a hole right through a thick sheet of iron.
pokedex.696: Its large jaw has incredible destructive power. Some theories suggest that its restored form is different from its form of long ago.
pokedex.697: Complete restoration is impossible, allowing room for theories that its entire body was once covered in a feather-like coat.
pokedex.698: It lived in cold areas in ancient times. It’s said that when Amaura whinnies, auroras appear in the night sky.
pokedex.699: An Aurorus was found frozen solid within a glacier, just as it appeared long ago, which became quite a big event in the news.
pokedex.700: Its ribbonlike feelers give off an aura that weakens hostility in its prey, causing them to let down their guard. Then it attacks.
pokedex.701: It overwhelms opponents with quick moves, but sometimes it showboats for too long when it’s using a special move and gets itself into a pinch.
pokedex.702: It sneaks into people’s homes and steals electricity from their outlets. When your electric bill seems off, it’s the handiwork of this rascal.
pokedex.703: Born from the high temperatures and pressures deep underground, it defends itself by firing beams from the jewel part of its body.
pokedex.704: The weakest of all Dragon-type Pokémon, it’s unable to breathe if its skin dries out, so it sticks to shady places.
pokedex.705: It has trouble drawing a line between friends and food. It will calmly try to melt and eat even those it gets along well with.
pokedex.706: An amazingly friendly Pokémon, but if left to itself, loneliness overcomes it, and it oozes gooey tears.
pokedex.707: This even-tempered Pokémon has a habit of collecting keys. It will sneak into people’s homes to steal their keys.
pokedex.708: These Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died in the forest. Their cries sound like eerie screams.
pokedex.709: This Pokémon is said to devour anyone daring to ravage the forest. To the creatures dwelling in the forest, it offers great kindness.
pokedex.714: Fruits are its favorite foods. This gourmet carefully picks out just the ripe ones using its sonar.
pokedex.715: Although it has a violent disposition, if you give it a nice ripe fruit that it loves, Noivern will suddenly become tame.
pokedex.718: This is Zygarde’s form when it has gathered 50% of its cells. It wipes out all those who oppose it, showing not a shred of mercy.
pokedex.742: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it’s able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.
pokedex.743: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.
pokedex.744: It’s considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.
pokedex.745: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.
pokedex.746: When it’s in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.
pokedex.747: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.
pokedex.748: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.
pokedex.749: The mud stuck to Mudbray’s hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.
pokedex.750: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.
pokedex.751: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.
pokedex.752: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.
pokedex.753: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. When night falls, it walks around looking for a safer place to sleep.
pokedex.754: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis’s vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.
pokedex.755: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.
pokedex.756: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.
pokedex.757: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.
